nodes.title: READ ME
widgets_values:
YuE2 on Mac (yue2.cpp, Metal)

1. Write style tags and lyrics in YuE2 Song. Lyrics use [Verse] [Chorus] [Bridge] tags.
2. Queue. YuE2 Render writes the score, the melody and the audio in one go.
3. The score it used comes out on the right: copy it if you like the melody.

Keep a melody, change the words:
un-bypass YuE2 Plan, or paste a saved score into a String (Multiline) node, connect it to YuE2 Render's score input, edit the lyrics, queue.

Models (auto-download on first run, about 4.3 GB) go to models/yue2:
YuE2-3B-Q8_0.gguf and YuE2-Vae-F32.gguf from HF Serveurperso/YuE2-GGUF.

M1 16 GB: a 55 s jingle takes about 7 min. Longer songs scale faster than linear.
duration is a cap: the model can end the song earlier.
